# Ank Square Private Limited

> Ank Square is a Patna, Bihar (India) based digital agency offering marketplace/merchant account management for Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, Ajio, Blinkit, JioMart and Nykaa sellers, custom website development, and digital marketing (SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads). The company states it has completed 500+ projects for 300+ clients with 5+ years of experience.

## Overview
- Legal name: Ank Square Private Limited
- Founder: Mukesh Kumar
- Address: Ramjaipal Road, Opp. Gola Road, Near Hotel Magadh Palace, Patna, Bihar 801503, India
- Email: contact@anksquare.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91-9939337638
- Entity types: Organization, LocalBusiness, ProfessionalService
- Serves: Indian brands, manufacturers and small businesses selling online or building SEO-friendly websites; remote services available

## Marketplace / Merchant Account Management
- [Merchant Account Management](https://www.anksquare.com/service/merchant-management): Setup, optimization, analytics, inventory
- [Amazon](https://www.anksquare.com/service/amazon): Account setup and verification, listing optimization, PPC
- [Flipkart](https://www.anksquare.com/service/flipkart): Seller registration and KYC, catalog management, promotions
- [Blinkit](https://www.anksquare.com/service/blinkit): Quick commerce integration, inventory syncing
- [Myntra](https://www.anksquare.com/service/myntra): Fashion onboarding, brand store setup
- [Meesho](https://www.anksquare.com/service/meesho): Bulk upload, reseller-friendly listings
- [Ajio](https://www.anksquare.com/service/ajio): Fashion onboarding, pricing strategy
- [JioMart](https://www.anksquare.com/service/jiomart): Grocery/FMCG listings, vendor portal setup
- [Nykaa](https://www.anksquare.com/service/nykaa): Beauty onboarding, brand page design
